# Paired tokens and a binary consumer

Two invariant unary tokens anchor both Object-bounded method formals of one
complete invariant/contravariant binary consumer. Fixed contexts bind no formal.
Public, package nested and virtual entries retain their original void calls.

Frozen source, package-source and SDK profiles compare destination identity,
virtual put effects, captured field snapshots, mutable provider fields, ignored
calls, late casts, null order and exact checked/Error identity. Independent wrong
programs must fail the observer, and compiler metadata remains unchanged.
